messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PRIVATE-VPC-CONTROLPLANE high-latency/packetloss to customer VPC (acct: acme-logistics). symptom: control-plane heartbeats delayed, 90% of agent pings >200ms, some 5% packet loss. Incident ID: PD-83421. link: https://pagerduty.example/PD-83421

pagerduty: Triggered service: private-controlplane-health. Escalation policy: oncall-sre -> eng-infra -> se-owners.

maria (oncall-sre): Acked. I'm looking. Any customer impact reported?

alex (sre): Seeing similar on infra dashboards — controlplane -> vpc-north-1 route shows queuing spikes and TCP retransmits. Could be flapping NAT gateway or route table churn.

raj (eng-infra): I see increased BGP flap counters on our eBGP session to the provider peer for that region. Noted on router rtr-nyc-03.

maria (oncall-sre): Confirmed impact: API controlplane heartbeats to acme's VPC at 10.20.0.0/16 are delayed; some agents report state=stalled and queued requests. Customer ticket already opened by support (TICKET-5582). @tina can you confirm customer-visible errors?

tina (support): Customer reports timeouts when submitting inference jobs to their private deployment. They saw 504s starting ~ 08:15 UTC. They can confirm business impact, low volume but critical pipeline blocked. I've DM'd Jen on CS to keep them posted.

jen (customer-success): On the customer call. They want ETA and whether to failover to hosted. Asking for root cause clarity.

alex (sre): Collecting traces. Pasting quick traceroute from a controlplane node to one of customer's agent IPs:

```
traceroute to 10.20.5.12 (10.20.5.12), 30 hops max, 60 byte packets
 1  10.1.0.1  0.6 ms  0.7 ms  0.6 ms
 2  100.64.0.5  1.1 ms  1.2 ms  1.1 ms
 3  rtr-nyc-03.example.net  45.2 ms  45.1 ms  46.0 ms
 4  * * *
```

alex (sre): hop 3 latency high and then blackhole.

raj (eng-infra): I'm SSHing to rtr-nyc-03 now. Running `show bgp summary` and `show ip route`.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: acknowledged by maria (oncall-sre) at 2350012350. Next escalation in 12m if no progress.

maria (oncall-sre): Quick mitigation plan: 1) Verify controlplane to agent connectivity; 2) If route flaps, failover route to backup provider; 3) If on-prem agent isolated, coordinate restart with customer; 4) Keep CS/Customer in loop. I'll lead incident commander.

raj (eng-infra): Found repeated BGP neighbor resets on peer peer-10. Provider shows interface errors (CRC). Opening ticket with provider. Temporary mitigation: routing-engine has secondary path via bgp-backup. I'm applying a policy to prefer backup path for prefix 10.20.0.0/16. Applying now.

alex (sre): After route preference switch, controlplane pings drop to sub-10ms and no retransmits. I'm seeing decreased queue length on controlplane pods.

maria (oncall-sre): :thumbsup: Good. Maria -> handing off to raj for monitoring and next steps. I'll remain as incident commander for comms until we verify stability for 30m.

raj (eng-infra): I'll watch BGP and provider ticket. Plan: keep backup path for 1h, monitor. If stable, we revert to primary off-peak.

tina (support): Notified customer: "We detected routing instability between our control plane and your VPC. We temporarily routed traffic over a backup path which should restore connectivity. Please retry your jobs and report errors." Customer acked and will test.

jen (customer-success): Customer requested an RCA email and whether they should enable hosted fallback. Shared instructions for temporary hosted failover.

alex (sre): Adding debug logs from controlplane pod for one stalled agent:

```
2026-03-14T08:18:12Z controlplane[main] INFO agent-connector: ping latency 450ms, retrying
2026-03-14T08:18:25Z controlplane[main] WARN agent-connector: queueing request for agent-10.20.5.12
2026-03-14T08:19:50Z controlplane[main] ERROR agent-connector: heartbeat timeout after 3 attempts
```

maria (oncall-sre): Marking incident as "mitigated" in PagerDuty. Will wait 30m to ensure no regressions before resolving. Creating incident doc: link placeholder: https://wiki.internal/incidents/PD-83421-rte.

incident-bot: PagerDuty note: status changed to Mitigated by maria at 2350012470.

raj (eng-infra): Provider escalated and acknowledged interface flaps; they schedule a hardware check on their side. We've requested a maintenance window if needed.

tina (support): Customer confirmed their jobs are now succeeding. They reported ~10-15 minute window of failures. No data loss.

maria (oncall-sre): Handoff: I'm leaving the rotation in 20m. Raj will own watch for 1h. Alex will prepare post-incident checks (controlplane metrics, agent reconnect rates). Tina/Jen: please send customer update with timeline and next steps.

jen (customer-success): On it. I'll send the email with summary + invite to RCA call tomorrow.

maria (oncall-sre): Thanks team. Closing slack updates; keep thread for followups. :white_check_mark:

raj (eng-infra): Follow-up items: (1) consider BGP flap alert tuning to reduce noise, (2) automate auto-failover to backup provider for critical customer prefixes, (3) run sim failover drill. Adding to eng-infra backlog.

alex (sre): Will run a sweep to find any other affected customers in that region.

incident-bot: Thread archived by incident-bot at 2350012590.
